Government Scrutinizes WhatsApp Username Feature Amid Fraud Concerns

The Indian government is reviewing WhatsApp's new username feature due to concerns about potential impersonation and cyber fraud. Authorities have issued notices and warnings to Meta, the parent company, emphasizing accountability for misuse. The feature, intended to enhance privacy, is now under scrutiny for its security implications.
